Typical client requirements

Situations where clients ask for infrastructure support.

  • Setting up IT for a new office
  • Expanding to additional rooms, floors, or sites
  • Replacing or upgrading ageing servers
  • Wi-Fi that does not cover the whole building
  • Moving some services to the cloud
  • Unclear or untested backup arrangements
  • Recurring network faults or slow connections
  • A review of existing infrastructure before investing

Frequently asked questions

What does an infrastructure assessment involve?

We review your current servers, network, cloud services, and backup arrangements against what your organization needs, then explain what we found and what we recommend. The scope is agreed with you first.

Do you install network cabling and fibre?

Structured network cabling is part of our service. Fibre-optic infrastructure is offered where available, so tell us about your site and we will confirm what is possible.

Can you help us move to the cloud?

We help with cloud infrastructure setup and administration, and with migration projects. We will discuss what suits your needs before recommending an approach.

Can you improve our network speed?

We troubleshoot and optimize networks, but results depend on your equipment, premises, and the connection you have. We do not promise specific speed improvements; we will tell you what we find.

Which vendors or brands do you work with?

We recommend equipment and services that fit your requirements. If you already use particular products, tell us and we will assess how to work with them.

How much does an infrastructure project cost?

It depends on the scope, so we do not publish prices. After an assessment, we prepare a quotation for your approval.
